frontier_2026_07_22.method: Official GitHub repository API for default-branch HEAD and latest release, then official specification and release notes for maturity. Search-index dates are not treated as current state.
frontier_2026_07_22.architecture_read: UCP and ACP define commerce exchange; AP2 defines delegated-payment mandates; A2A connects independent agents; MCP exposes tools, resources and optional apps; AG-UI/A2UI carry agent-to-user UI; an agent framework or durable runtime implements behavior underneath. These layers are complementary, not interchangeable workflow products.

collection_chain.production_owner: KJDS Evidence pipeline and persisted state machine
lane_order: deterministic authenticated browser or CLI adapter
AI browser fallback for unstable layouts

collection_chain.global_boundary: Collectors may create immutable research artifacts only. They cannot create formal facts, approvals, permits, purchases, payments, listings or advertisements.

stages.purpose: Verify owner, terms, license, endpoint and permitted use before collection.
stages.primary: official platform documentation and owned-account export
stages.fallback: reviewed upstream repository and dated terms snapshot
stages.boundary: Search snippets and reseller claims stay requires_review.
stages.verification: URL, captured_at, version or commit, license and content hash

stages.purpose: Bind every authenticated read to the intended legal account, store and region.
stages.primary: least-privilege API identity or dedicated KJDS browser profile
stages.fallback: visible human-confirmed session with whoami readback
stages.boundary: Never export cookies, passwords, MFA secrets or reuse the personal CPA/2FA profile.
stages.verification: account identifier, nick or store, domain, region and session timestamp
stages.provenance: private session attestation and hashed readback

stages.purpose: Use the most authoritative and stable machine-readable source first.
stages.primary: Ozon Seller API or official 28-day export; 1688 Open Platform after approval
stages.fallback: authenticated deterministic browser adapter
stages.boundary: Read-only scope until the existing permit chain authorizes an exact write.
stages.verification: HTTP status, account scope, requested interval, control totals and raw response hash
stages.provenance: immutable raw response or original export

stages.purpose: Collect authenticated data when no approved API or export exists.
stages.primary: pinned 1688-cli or Playwright adapter using a dedicated KJDS profile
stages.fallback: visible manual export or screenshot with account context
stages.boundary: Domain allowlist, loopback control, one writer and no checkout, order or payment action.
stages.verification: 10 of 10 runs across two restarts, exact account and item, zero cross-account leakage
stages.provenance: tool version, commit, run event, server message ID and artifact hash

stages.purpose: Recover from layout drift without replacing deterministic adapters.
stages.primary: Stagehand, browser-use or Skyvern isolated trial behind the same browser boundary
stages.fallback: visible human takeover
stages.boundary: No anti-bot bypass; no direct side effect; every proposed action is previewed and read back.
stages.verification: gold-page replay, domain confinement, action diff and failure handoff
stages.provenance: prompt, model, tool version, screenshot and DOM snapshot

stages.purpose: Preserve the source before parsing or normalization.
stages.primary: original API body, export, download, DOM snapshot or server message payload
stages.fallback: dated screenshot plus manually exported text
stages.boundary: Raw artifacts are append-only and private when they contain account data.
stages.verification: source URL, captured_at, account scope, byte length and SHA-256

stages.purpose: Reject malicious, unsupported or over-scoped files before parsing.
stages.primary: type, size, archive, malware and privacy checks
stages.fallback: quarantine for manual inspection
stages.boundary: Credentials and unrelated personal data are redacted or rejected, never copied into prompts.
stages.verification: declared type versus magic bytes, scan result, redaction log and quarantine reason

stages.purpose: Transform source bytes into versioned structured records without losing source fields.
stages.primary: source-specific parser with explicit schema version
stages.fallback: OCR or manual structured transcription with independent review
stages.boundary: Parser output remains research until promotion rules pass.
stages.verification: gold fixtures, UNKNOWN handling, control totals and parser-version replay

stages.purpose: Map marketplace IDs, supplier IDs and variants without fuzzy accidental joins.
stages.primary: platform item ID, supplier login ID and explicit SKU mapping
stages.fallback: reviewed candidate match with confidence and unresolved status
stages.boundary: Names and image similarity cannot silently merge suppliers or SKUs.
stages.verification: stable identifiers, normalized variants, collision test and reviewer
stages.provenance: mapping record linked to both source artifacts

stages.purpose: Prove complete time windows and pagination rather than a plausible sample.
stages.primary: explicit cursor traversal and platform totals for continuous at least 28 days
stages.fallback: daily exports with gap detection and reconciliation
stages.boundary: A seven-day page cannot be extrapolated or labeled as 28-day actual data.
stages.verification: timezone, start, end, page count, row count, platform total and gap list
stages.provenance: collection manifest and raw page hashes

stages.purpose: Make retries safe and preserve changes over time.
stages.primary: content hash plus platform-native message, item or report ID
stages.fallback: canonical record hash with conservative duplicate review
stages.boundary: Deduplication suppresses duplicate writes but never deletes conflicting evidence.
stages.verification: idempotency replay, duplicate count and conflict retention

stages.purpose: Keep every value tied to its source and uncertainty.
stages.primary: field-level source pointer, observed_at, confidence and actual/research/estimate class
stages.fallback: UNKNOWN with reason
stages.boundary: Missing data is UNKNOWN, never invented or filled by a model guess.
stages.verification: all decision fields have provenance or explicit UNKNOWN

stages.purpose: Separate collector success from factual and business acceptance.
stages.primary: independent reviewer checks source, scope, controls and business fitness
stages.fallback: human review queue
stages.boundary: The collecting agent cannot self-promote its own unverified output.
stages.verification: review decision, findings, reviewer identity and timestamp

stages.purpose: Create an immutable Evidence object from accepted research artifacts.
stages.primary: existing KJDS Evidence and lineage contracts
stages.fallback: quarantined research artifact pending adapter support
stages.boundary: No second evidence store or agent-owned truth database.
stages.verification: schema, hash, source, observed_at, effective_at and parent lineage

stages.purpose: Control research to formal fact to actual transitions.
stages.primary: existing Approval and formal-fact promotion policy
stages.fallback: remain research or estimate
stages.boundary: Only original evidence plus independent review may promote; supplier acknowledgement is not a quote.
stages.verification: promotion decision cites exact Evidence IDs and classification

stages.purpose: Turn breakage into reusable protection for later SKUs.
stages.primary: gold fixtures, schema drift checks and quarantined failures
stages.fallback: manual adapter repair followed by replay
stages.boundary: Drift fails closed and cannot silently drop or relabel fields.
stages.verification: old and new fixtures replay with explicit diff acceptance
stages.provenance: fixture hash, failure signature and regression test

stages.purpose: Handle rate limits, retries, session expiry and challenges predictably.
stages.primary: bounded retry, backoff, circuit breaker and resumable cursor
stages.fallback: one human_required event with exact continuation point
stages.boundary: No CAPTCHA or MFA bypass and no retry storm or duplicate external action.
stages.verification: fault injection, retry budget, single takeover event and duplicate-action count

stages.purpose: Verify the external system accepted the exact action or returned the expected data.
stages.primary: platform-native ID and server-side readback
stages.fallback: visible page readback with artifact hash
stages.boundary: A click, local success message or user attestation alone is not completion.
stages.verification: request hash, target, server ID, response, timestamps and reconciliation result
stages.provenance: RU-001 private readback has no KJDS ExecutionPermit; future authorized writes must link Readback to ExecutionPermit

stages.purpose: Expire sessions and retain only the evidence needed for audit.
stages.primary: account-scoped retention schedule and credential revocation procedure
stages.fallback: manual quarantine and access removal
stages.boundary: Private profiles and exports stay outside Git; no credential backup in evidence bundles.
stages.verification: retention age, revocation drill and access audit

stages.purpose: Detect stale, incomplete or unsafe collection before decisions consume it.
stages.primary: source freshness, completeness, error budget and provenance monitors
stages.fallback: explicit blocked or stale status in the decision packet
stages.owner: existing authority radar and KJDS health checks
stages.boundary: Source failure is not reported as no change or no data.
stages.verification: scheduled run history, alerts, incident outcome and recovery replay

stages.purpose: Measure whether automation reduces total work and errors rather than moving them.
stages.primary: per-stage machine time, human minutes, retries and external cost
stages.fallback: manual baseline with confidence interval
stages.boundary: Adopt a tool only on measured value, stability and risk, not installation count.
stages.verification: same-scope before and after comparison including review and recovery time

stages.purpose: Make every successful or failed run reduce the cost and risk of the next SKU.
stages.primary: versioned adapter, field map, fixture, failure signature, test, evidence template and runbook delta
stages.fallback: documented non-reusable reason with an owner
stages.boundary: Reusable assets cannot weaken approval, permit, provenance or readback controls.
stages.verification: asset IDs referenced by the next SKU and measured reuse ratio
stages.provenance: asset manifest linked to originating run

compounding_contract.principle: Every run must leave reusable assets and a lower-cost, lower-risk path for the next comparable SKU.
required_assets_per_run: source adapter or explicit adapter gap
measured manual minutes and machine cost
compounding_contract.promotion_rule: A new tool or optimization becomes default only after representative outcome tests pass stability, quality, permission, provenance, rollback and total-cost thresholds.
